entries.aa84d1d295f6b2f5: The corporate philosophy is 'to realize a comfortable lifestyle through the distribution of equipment products and services.' As its medium-term goals, it has set three 'Full' targets (full coverage, full line and full function), Mirai-kai activities and evolution activities, and through pursuit of three 'Best' goals it aims to become a company that is told 'thank you' by seven stakeholders. As a management target, it has set net sales growth of 2.5% or more versus the previous year.
entries.ae42775ee4f044e5: Its strengths are a prefecture-based sales structure that responds to demand nationwide, a product lineup that covers everything from piping materials to housing equipment and air-conditioning equipment and pumps on a one-stop basis, and a prompt delivery system through nationwide branches and distribution centers. It also has a mechanism linking customers and suppliers through the Mirai-kai network.
